title: Stage opted-in beta emails from FlowWeb into the draft-only Email Studio queue
description: The email-queue flow already validates and stores drafts on the Owner's Mac, but flowweb.app cannot stage one. Add a paired-Owner composer for the existing email-queue flow and route its request through the hosted request queue and relay to POST /v1/flows/email-queue/drafts. Accept only subscribed_members, keep campaign content as a template for Email Studio, and show the existing facts gate result. This row adds no send, schedule, approval, outbox, or spend path.
acceptance: The Flows inbox for email-queue presents an accessible stage form with asset, subject, optional preheader, body and the subscribed_members audience only
A paired Owner can stage through the existing hosted request queue; the relay forwards only POST /v1/flows/email-queue/drafts with the validated content to the local Owner machine
The local flow's existing facts gate decides waiting_for_owner or gate_blocked, and the result is visible beside the saved draft in the inbox
Unauthenticated, malformed, oversized, unsupported-audience and unknown-flow requests are refused without creating a draft
Staging creates no outbox item, send, schedule, approval, provider call or spend record; there is no send or schedule control in this UI
